# Secure Locksmith Paris

> English-speaking locksmith in Paris (75), across all 20 arrondissements, 24/7. Slammed door opening from €110 incl. VAT, price given on the phone before travelling, written quote signed before any work, invoice accepted by French home insurers.

## Information
- Name: Secure Locksmith Paris (Secure Lock Serrurerie)
- Phone: +33 6 67 96 96 20, 24/7
- WhatsApp: https://wa.me/33667969620
- Email: securelockserrurerie@gmail.com
- Website: https://securelockserrurerie.com/
- Area: Paris only, 1st to 20th arrondissement
- Average arrival: about 30 minutes
- Languages: English, French
- Payment: card, cash, bank transfer
- Google rating: 5.0/5 (101 reviews)

## Services
- [Lockout & door opening](https://securelockserrurerie.com/services/door-opening/): from €110. Locked out, keys left inside: we open your door gently, with no damage and no lock change in most cases.
- [Jammed lock repair](https://securelockserrurerie.com/services/jammed-lock/): from €180. Key won't turn, stiff cylinder, stuck bolt: on-site diagnosis and repair rather than replacement.
- [Broken key extraction](https://securelockserrurerie.com/services/broken-key/): free quote. Piece of key stuck in the cylinder: clean extraction without changing the lock, plus advice on what to do next.
- [Lock & cylinder replacement](https://securelockserrurerie.com/services/lock-replacement/): from €160. Lost or stolen keys, moving in, worn lock: new cylinder or A2P multi-point lock fitted the same day.
- [Break-in repair & securing](https://securelockserrurerie.com/services/break-in-repair/): free quote. Forced door or burglary: emergency temporary locking, lock replacement, reinforcement and paperwork for your insurer.
- [Smart lock installation & repair](https://securelockserrurerie.com/services/smart-lock/): free quote. Installation and repair of smart locks: open with your phone, a code, a badge or your fingerprint.
- [Door armoring (reinforcement)](https://securelockserrurerie.com/services/door-armoring/): from €2,300. Reinforce your existing door: steel plate, multi-point lock and anti-jemmy bars, without changing its look from the landing.
- [Armored door installation](https://securelockserrurerie.com/services/armored-door/): from €3,350. A2P BP1, BP2 or BP3 certified armored door set: door, frame and multi-point lock designed together and made to measure.
- [Armored cellar door](https://securelockserrurerie.com/services/cellar-door/): from €1,550. Cellar broken into or poorly protected: steel cellar door set with a security lock, made to fit your opening.
- [Mailbox lock replacement](https://securelockserrurerie.com/services/mailbox-lock/): from €110. Lost key, broken lock or moving in: we replace the lock on your mailbox and supply new keys.
